text:
anya (Design): quick design check — finalizing validation patterns for the new Create Pool flow. proposal: show inline errors next to fields as users type, only show a concise top summary when there are more than three errors. required indicator debate: visible 'Required' label (low-contrast) vs classic asterisk. destructive flow: typed-confirm for production-critical pools, checkbox + soft-undo for non-critical. thoughts + accessibility considerations? kevin (Product): inline errors preferred. users like immediate feedback. top summary for long forms makes sense. recommend we iterate on wording for the summary so it's helpful. jamal (Eng): inline errors easiest on the frontend; keeps error DOM local to inputs. implementation note: avoid moving focus unless user submits — focus jumps are jarring. also recommend error anchors (id references) for keyboard navigation. linda (Design): +1 inline. regarding required marker: asterisk alone can be ambiguous in user tests. prefer explicit 'Required' visually but keep contrast low so it doesn't compete with the label. show it only for mandatory fields (not every field). chris (a11y): asterisk by itself often isn't exposed to SRs. if we keep an asterisk, ensure aria-required="true" on the input and include hidden text after the label for screen readers. if we use visible 'Required', include sr-only text as well. inline errors should use role="alert" and aria-live="assertive"; on form submit, focus should move to the first errored control. shawn (DevEx): small example we can include in the SDK docs:
Name is required
marie (PM): destructive copy nit: use explicit verbs like 'Delete pool' and clear instructions. for typed-confirm copy: 'Type the pool name to confirm deletion.' add short 'This cannot be undone' subtext. typed-confirm should be reserved for system-critical pools only. for others, a checkbox + short undo (30s) should be sufficient. kevin (Product): agree. we should categorize pools (prod vs dev) so UI shows the right confirmation. also consider email or audit log entries for typed deletions. anya (Design): accessibility question: typed-confirm requires typing the exact name — how do SR users handle this? any accessibility pitfalls? chris (a11y): typed-confirm is okay if we provide alternatives: allow a keyboard-only two-step modal (clear buttons) and ensure the typed input has an explicit label and aria-describedby pointing at the hint. make matching case-insensitive and trim whitespace to avoid unnecessary failures. document these behaviors in the a11y checklist. jamal (Eng): implementation details: make match case-insensitive, strip leading/trailing whitespace, and disable autocomplete/autofill on the typed-confirm input. small cost on frontend. also validate server-side as final guard. linda (Design): UI suggestion: compact typed input with inline match indicator (icon + color). keep primary CTA disabled until match. microcopy: placeholder 'enter pool name to confirm' and show the exact name in bold above the input. shawn (DevEx): edge case: browsers sometimes autofill recent form fields. set autocomplete="off" and aria-autocomplete="none" on the confirm input. we'll add SDK helper to render the typed-confirm block consistently. marie (PM): decision proposal: 1) Inline errors by default, top summary only when >3 errors. 2) Use visible 'Required' for mandatory fields (low-contrast) + aria-required and sr-only label text. 3) Destructive: typed-confirm for production-critical pools, checkbox+undo for others. 4) Accessibility checklist: role=alert on errors, focus management to first error, aria-describedby on typed-confirm, autocomplete disabled. kevin (Product): sounds good. let's ship a staged prototype and run a quick a11y sweep before launching. anya (Design): I'll update the design spec and upload mocks to Figma. action items for Eng and A11y below in the spec. please react if you agree. :thumbsup: ops-bot: deploy preview for PR #4212 is ready: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/4212 shawn (DevEx): thumbs up. will add SDK example and autofill notes. chris (a11y): approving with checklist additions. will author SR test cases. :white_check_mark: linda (Design): updating mocks and visual contrast tests now. marie (PM): I'll update the rollout doc and include monitoring for accidental deletions. anya (Design): thanks all — closing when PR and spec are merged.
